core.description: Hybrid texture imposed on the neutrino mass matrix.

core.name: dark matter mass
core.description: Mass of the lightest singlet fermion N1.
core.range: O(1 TeV); viable texture upper bounds span 2.27-5.31 TeV in the paper

core.name: next singlet mass
core.description: Mass of the nearly degenerate singlet fermion N2.

core.name: third singlet mass
core.description: Heavier singlet fermion mass with M1 approximately M2 < M3.

core.name: inert scalar mass scale
core.description: Average neutral inert-scalar mass used in loop and coannihilation formulae.

core.name: Yukawa couplings
core.description: Lepton-flavor Yukawa couplings linking L_alpha, eta, and N_k.
core.range: bounded by neutrino and lepton-flavor-violation inputs

core.name: effective Majorana mass
core.description: Neutrinoless double beta decay amplitude parameter; a lower bound on |M_ee| is reported for this viable texture class.

derived.name: thermal average effective cross section
derived.description: Coannihilation cross section used for relic-density calculation.

derived.name: relic abundance
derived.description: Observed value used as target in the paper.

validity_domain.condition: N1 stability requires the exact Z2 assignment used in the scotogenic model.
The relic-density calculation assumes N1 is nearly degenerate with N2.
Texture T4 remains among the five viable textures after applying the observed relic-density criterion; T2 is disallowed in the paper.

global.description: The relic density is computed with standard thermal freeze-out using x_f about 25.
global.impact_if_violated: A nonstandard cosmological history would change the inferred M1 range.

global.description: The dark matter candidate N1 is almost degenerate with N2 for coannihilation.
global.impact_if_violated: Large splitting would invalidate the coannihilation formula used in the paper.

global.description: The neutrino mass matrix obeys hybrid texture T4.
global.impact_if_violated: Changing the texture changes the link between M_ee, Yukawa couplings, and relic density.

robustness.notes: The paper gives explicit formulae and numerical correlations, but this card does not reproduce the numerical scan.

warnings.warning: Do not merge texture T4 with other scotogenic hybrid textures; relic-density and M_ee conclusions are texture-dependent.
warnings.mitigation: Track the texture label as a core model parameter.

primary_papers.title: Scotogenesis in Hybrid Textures of Neutrino Mass Matrix and Neutrinoless Double Beta Decay
primary_papers.notes: Assigned SQLite full text used as the only source.

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: The paper studies dark matter and neutrinoless double beta decay in scotogenic hybrid textures.
It adds three singlet fermions and an inert scalar doublet, all odd under exact Z2.
It identifies N1 as the dark matter candidate and computes coannihilation relic density.
Texture T4 is one of the viable texture variants after applying relic-density consistency.
